dataset.title: Galle

records.sentence: The bay of Galle lies off the southwest coast of Sri Lanka, sheltered by a rocky peninsula.

records.sentence: Mentioned as early as 545 in the cosmography of Cosmas Indicopleustes, it is one of the most ancient “ports of call of the levant.”
When Ibn Batuta landed there in 1344, it was the principal port of Ceylon.

records.sentence: They encircled the whole of the peninsula with a bastioned stone wall so as to render it impregnable against the English, French, Danish, Spanish, and Portuguese fleets vying with Holland for the supremacy of the sea.

records.sentence: It is this fortified city built by the Dutch which exist today with but few changes.

records.sentence: It housed 500 families, and a large number of public administrations, trade establishments and warehouses were located there.

records.sentence: The forge, carpentry and ropemaking workshops, the naval guardhouse, and barracks rounded out a system that closely linked prosperous trade to military security.

records.sentence: The fort of Galle was handed over to the English only on 23 February 1796, one week after the surrender of Colombo.

entities.label: historic

records.sentence: Galle remains the best example of a fortified city build by Europeans in South and Southeast Asia.

entities.label: historic
entities.text: from the 16th to the 19 the centuries

records.sentence: Galle provides an outstanding example of an urban ensemble which illustrates the interaction of European architecture and South Asian traditions from the 16th to the 19 the centuries.

entities.label: scientific
entities.text: original sewer system from the 17th century

records.sentence: Among the characteristics which make this an urban group of exceptional value is the original sewer system from the 17th century, flushed with sea water controlled by a pumping station formerly activated by a windmill on the Triton bastion.
However, the most salient fact is the use of European models adapted by local manpower to the geological, climatic, historic and cultural conditions of Sri Lanka.
